articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $90M as BTC sits 32% below year-old ATH
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs reversed two days of inflows as Bitcoin slipped below $86,000, trading roughly 32% below its October 2025 all-time high.

articles.title: EEZ tests atomic L1-to-L2 transaction in push to unify Ethereum
articles.description: An EEZ contributor shared a 0.001 ETH cross-chain test as the project develops a framework to connect Ethereum mainnet and its rollups.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Better Markets says CFTC is ‘wrong agency’ to regulate retail crypto
articles.description: Better Markets said the CFTC’s proposed framework to bring certain cryptocurrency transactions and exchanges under its oversight will leave investors less protected than under the SEC.

articles.title: Rain seeks US trust bank charter days after OCC sued over crypto charters
articles.description: Rain joins a growing queue of crypto firms seeking federal trust charters, while community banks have just asked a court to overturn the OCC rules underpinning them.

articles.title: OKX eyes emerging markets with yield-offering stablecoin savings and payments app
articles.description: OKX Money lets users hold, send and spend dollar-backed stablecoins, with qualifying USDG balances earning up to 10% APY.

articles.title: Chinese crime network laundered over $1B for Lazarus: ZachXBT
articles.description: ZachXBT says he infiltrated the network by posing as a customer, gaining information that helped trace funds from the $1.5 billion Bybit hack.

articles.title: Crypto PAC announces support for 32 House candidates in US midterms
articles.description: Fairshake said it would financially back 32 House candidates who all voted in favor of the CLARITY market structure bill in 2025, as the legislation remains in limbo in the Senate.

articles.title: FinCEN withdraws proposed crypto mixing rule over ‘legitimate activity’ concerns
articles.description: The bureau under the US Treasury said it was withdrawing two proposed rules on unhosted wallets and crypto mixers ”as part of the Trump Administration’s deregulatory agenda.”

articles.title: Modern Treasury seeks US trust bank charter for digital asset custody
articles.description: The payments infrastructure company is seeking federal approval to offer stablecoin custody and related fiat services through a limited-purpose national trust bank.

articles.title: Advocacy group pushes back on banks’ lawsuit against OCC over charters
articles.description: CCI CEO Ji Hun Kim said that the organization “remains confident“ in the OCC’s approval of charters for crypto companies, despite a recent lawsuit and pushback from some lawmakers.

articles.title: S&P Global brings risk assessments to growing crypto lending vault sector
articles.description: S&P Global’s new framework evaluates digital asset lending vaults across six risk categories as deposits in the sector climb to about $10 billion.

articles.title: CFTC joins SEC in proposing crypto framework after failed CLARITY vote
articles.description: CFTC Chair Michael Selig claimed that the agency was using its “existing statutory authorities“ to address crypto regulation after Congress failed to advance a market structure bill.

articles.title: Treasury yields at 5% threaten extending Bitcoin’s best quarter since 2017
articles.description: Weak US jobs data has narrowed expectations for another Fed hike in October, offering Bitcoin some relief as investors continue to embrace the debasement trade.

articles.title: Bitcoin price fails to break higher after best weekly close in eight months
articles.description: Bitcoin’s highest weekly close in eight months formed low-timeframe resistance at the start of Monday’s US trading session.

articles.title: Metaplanet reveals net income strategy to fuel Bitcoin accumulation
articles.description: Metaplanet revealed a revised capital allocation framework proposing to allocate as much as 15% of total assets to strategic investments to fund its Bitcoin accumulation.

articles.title: Strategy opts for bigger spending on STRC buybacks over BTC purchases
articles.description: Strategy bought 334 Bitcoin for $28.7 million last week while spending $176.3 million to repurchase about 1.77 million shares of STRC.

articles.title: China P2P stablecoin wallets grew 43x despite crypto restrictions: Chainalysis
articles.description: Unique wallets sending P2P stablecoin transactions in China grew 43-fold between Q1 2024 and Q2 2026 as crypto activity increasingly shifted toward direct wallet-to-wallet transfers.

articles.title: Too big to pause: Could an AI slowdown crash the economy?
articles.description: Calls to slow down development of the most powerful AI models are colliding with an $800 billion investment boom. Could an AI slowdown tank the US economy?

articles.title: Vivek Ramaswamy’s gubernatorial run lacks the crypto rhetoric of his presidential bid
articles.description: The Ohio Republican candidate holds a stake in a digital asset manager and received donations from many in the industry, but has avoided making crypto a central campaign issue.

articles.title: BTC price fights to reclaim 2026 open: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.description: Bitcoin bulls renewed pressure on range highs with the 2026 yearly open forming the next key resistance to break through.

articles.title: Kraken parent adds 24/7 dollar settlement with Singapore Gulf Bank
articles.description: The partnership will enable select institutions in Asia and the Gulf region to instantly settle US dollar transactions through the bank’s SGB Net

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs notch third inflow week as Ether ETFs shed $138M
articles.description: Bitcoin ETF inflows reached a third straight week, while Ether ETFs swung to outflows and Zcash funds posted their first weekly outflow.

articles.title: Zcash activates NU7 on testnet ahead of November mainnet target
articles.description: Zcash’s NU7 upgrade is now live on testnet, giving developers several weeks to assess 25-second blocks and other protocol changes before a planned November mainnet activation.

articles.title: OKX, NYSE parent file to launch tokenized US stock platform
articles.description: The stock trading platform seeks to offer tokenized shares in more than 60 US-listed companies under the SEC’s recently introduced innovation exemption.

articles.title: Safe investor asks Swiss watchdog to intervene in governance dispute
articles.description: Greenfield Capital said it sought changes to Safe Ecosystem Foundation’s board for months before turning to the Swiss regulator.

articles.title: Zcash gets a Washington lobbyist to push crypto policy
articles.description: The newly registered lobbying operation lists the CLARITY Act and two digital asset tax proposals among the issues it plans to lobby on in Washington.

articles.title: Former SEC boss made AI Czar, Bitcoin may hit $600K this cycle: Hodler’s Digest
articles.description: Roman Storm and the XRP army aren’t happy former SEC boss Jay Clayton is Trump’s new AI czar, Peter Brandt flips bullish and says Bitcoin may reach as high as $600K by 2029.

articles.title: Trump taps intel chief Jay Clayton to lead new Super Intelligence Force
articles.description: President Donald Trump said US intel chief Clayton will lead the SIF, reporting to the president and Chief of Staff Susie Wiles.

articles.title: Japan adds Garantex to list of Russia sanctions over Ukraine war
articles.description: Garantex was previously sanctioned by the US, the EU and other jurisdictions for helping Russian entities evade financial restrictions.
